regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, DOI, and introductory text
regions.finding: Verified the full source title and the article-level claim of Pd-catalyzed aminoalkynylation/alleneamination. Introductory cited chemistry was treated as context rather than current experiments.

Visually inspected and classified four separate transition-metal/diaziridinone arrows as cited prior-literature examples (three labeled Shi's work and one Hu's work); generic structures and absent conditions remain unresolved.
Visually inspected and classified Gong's diene/urea diamination and Lin-Yao enyne/urea sequence as two cited prior-work examples, not present-paper preparations.

Classified the aminoalkynylation and alleneamination arrows as two current general schemes. Retained the printed aggregate counts/maxima (34 examples/up to 98%; 19 examples/up to 83%) while concrete runs are represented on later pages.

unresolved: Scheme 1 prior/current overview drawings contain generic R groups and do not define complete experiment-specific structures or conditions.
No workspace Supporting Information association is established.

regions.finding: Mapped prose values and catalyst/ligand/base/air/scale observations to the corresponding Table 1 rows without creating prose duplicates. Solvent/control results delegated to SI were not inferred.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Table 1 reaction drawing, entries 1-17, and footnotes a-e
regions.finding: Recorded all 17 rows independently with shared charges, 80 °C/24 h/toluene/argon conditions, row catalyst-ligand-base identities, 10 mol% catalyst override for entries 7-10, air override for entry 16, scale override for entry 17, isolated yields, and NR outcomes.

regions.region: page 2 right-column Scheme 2 reaction header, products 3b-3o, X-ray drawing, caption and footnote
regions.finding: Recorded fourteen distinct urea-linked-alkene scope rows with exact isolated yields and shared reagent amounts/conditions. Product 3l receives the explicit 48 h footnote; 3b is linked to its X-ray characterization and later CCDC accession.

unresolved: Table 1 and Scheme 2 omit workups, purifications, isolated masses, and NR/trace detection limits.
Control and alternative-solvent details are referred to unassociated SI and were not imported.
Compact scope structures remain source-labeled where safe encoding was uncertain.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left Scheme 3 reaction header, products 4a-4s, caption
regions.finding: Recorded all nineteen alkynyl-bromide scope arrows independently with the displayed 0.3/0.45 mmol charges, Pd2(dba)3/XantPhos/NaOtBu/toluene doses, 80 °C/24 h/argon program, and product-specific isolated yields.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Scheme 4 reaction header, products 6a-6s, X-ray drawing, caption and footnote
regions.finding: Recorded all nineteen alleneamination scope arrows independently with displayed charges/loadings/solvent, standard 80 °C/24 h/argon program, 6s footnote override to 100 °C/12 h, exact yields, and the 6r 1.4:1 dr. Product 6b is linked to X-ray/CCDC characterization.

regions.region: page 3 lower prose on scale-up, derivatizations and asymmetric study
regions.finding: Mapped the 4.5 mmol scale-up, four distinct derivatizations, and asymmetric 3b experiment to Scheme 5 on page 4; no duplicate narrative records were created.

regions.region: page 3 right-column isotope study and mechanism discussion
regions.finding: Mapped the (E)-1m-D reaction to one concrete 60%/9:1 dr experiment and the A-D/C' cycle to one proposed-mechanism record. The SI-only mechanism for product 6 was not inferred.

unresolved: Schemes 3-4 omit row-specific workups, purifications, masses, and most analytical bases.
The Scheme 5/6 prose does not add missing absolute scales or timings beyond the source figures.
The analytical basis for 6r dr and the isotope-study dr is not stated.

regions.finding: Recorded the independent 1b 4.5 mmol/2a 6.75 mmol preparation of 3b with printed catalyst/ligand/base conditions, 1.0018 g isolated mass, and 73% isolated yield. Unprinted time and solvent volume remain missing.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Scheme 5b four synthetic transformations
regions.finding: Recorded four separate arrows: 3b->7 triflic-acid cyclization, 3b->8 Pd/formic-acid reduction, ordered -78 °C to room-temperature DIBAL-H conversion 3b->9, and 6b->10 periodate/RuCl3 oxidation. Every displayed reagent dose, solvent ratio/volume, time/temperature, and product yield is structured.
Recorded the distinct Pd2(dba)3/(R,Rs)-MingPhos aminoalkynylation to 3b with 76% isolated yield and 43% ee; unprinted scale, time, and ee method remain missing.

regions.region: page 4 middle-left Scheme 6a isotope experiment and 6b proposed cycle
regions.finding: Recorded the deuterium-labeled standard-condition experiment separately from the proposed A-D/C' mechanism. The isotope row retains 60% isolated yield and 9:1 dr; proposed intermediates are not treated as preparations.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left data availability and crystallographic statements
regions.finding: The paper advertises SI, but source mapping leaves SI association unestablished. CCDC 2471274 (3b) and 2471288 (6b) were linked as characterization provenance to existing scope records only.
Bibliography/prior literature only. Cited external experiments were not expanded into current-paper experiment records.

unresolved: Scheme 5 omits several absolute scales, solvent volumes, reaction times, atmospheres, workups, purifications, masses, and analytical bases as documented in each record.
The DIBAL-H arrow gives a -78 °C-to-room-temperature program without stage durations; missing timing was not fabricated.
Online SI availability does not establish a workspace SI association.
Proposed mechanism intermediates are not independently observed or quantified.
